tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Torus and Klein bottle as symmetry-group quotients of the plane] ↗ prop:covering-space-action-quotient 1. ch1:1.42\group Covering Spaces

Integer translations of $\R ^2$ give the torus quotient and symmetry group $\Z \times \Z $. Adding glide-reflection symmetries of the alternating grid gives the Klein bottle quotient; its translation subgroup has index two. \end{example}
